name: @singularity/plugin-database-client-tools
description: Postgres client tools (pg_dump, pg_restore) from the same release as the embedded server.

wraps.name: PostgreSQL
wraps.prerequisite: publish @equin/pg-client-* for PostgreSQL <version> from github.com/equinai/pg-client-embedded (bump PG_VERSION in scripts/build.sh and EMBEDDED_POSTGRES_VERSION in the workflow, then tag v<version>; its CI smoke test needs the matching @embedded-postgres release), then upgrade

groups.reason: pg_dump / pg_restore must come from the same Postgres release (major.minor) as the embedded server
groups.prerequisite: publish @equin/pg-client-* for the new Postgres release from github.com/equinai/pg-client-embedded (bump PG_VERSION in scripts/build.sh and EMBEDDED_POSTGRES_VERSION in the workflow, then tag v<major>.<minor>.0), then upgrade again — the two move together
